release_notes: iPhone 18 models are now supported: Ghostly installs Apple's developer support files the same way Xcode does on the newest iPhones. Schedules can start at a time you pick instead of the moment you tap Start. Tapping Retry while Ghostly is reconnecting no longer ends the session with "could not reconnect after 5 minutes", and the connection that failed its handshake on some iPhones running iOS 27.2 now finds the right port.
